speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with gait and limb ataxia, and you have a significant medical history; to begin our assessment, could you please specify which conditions comprise your medical history and when these ataxic symptoms first appeared?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description; the "drunk" appearance and right-sided clumsiness suggest cerebellar involvement. To narrow this down, can you tell me if you have noticed any speech difficulties, such as slurring, or if your handwriting has become shaky? Additionally, do you have any history of head trauma, multiple sclerosis, or autoimmune disorders?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.
